'''Anarq''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith officer]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] where she sold light armor.

==Behind the scenes==
Anarq appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Light Armor Vendor for Imperial players on Dromund Kaas.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> she was removed from the game along with the rest of the Light Armor Vendors.<ref name="TOR" />
